risks.note: Company-stated: demand may be affected by changing consumer preferences, seasonal trends and macroeconomic conditions. Mitigated through a diversified product portfolio, regular product introductions and an extensive distribution network catering to multiple customer segments. Management separately reports muted consumer demand and continued pressure on discretionary spending, particularly in the mass and value segments, which is exactly where this company sells.

Company-stated: fluctuations in the prices of key raw materials may impact profitability. Mitigated through strategic sourcing, supplier diversification, raw material import price optimisation and cost optimisation initiatives. Sharpened by the Company's own disclosure that at the fag end of FY 2025-26 the gulf conflict has set in uncertainties as to sourcing and pricing of petroleum based raw materials, and that input cost increase from the prolonged global conflict has carried over to FY 2026-27 till date — material for a portfolio built on EVA, PVC, PVC DIP and PU.

Company-stated: dependence on an extensive distributor network may affect market reach and product availability. Mitigated by strengthening channel relationships, enhancing distributor engagement and improving supply chain efficiencies. Structurally load-bearing because the entire business is wholesale distribution through 791 distributors selling into multi-brand outlets, with no owned retail channel described.

Company-stated: intense competition from organised and unorganised players may exert pressure on pricing and market share. Mitigated through product quality, competitive pricing, product innovation and brand visibility.

Company-stated: disruptions in manufacturing, logistics or the supply chain may impact business continuity. Mitigated through established operational processes, a diversified vendor base and continuous monitoring of supply chain performance.

Company-stated: changes in statutory, taxation and regulatory requirements may impact operations. Mitigated by internal processes to monitor regulatory developments and ensure timely compliance. Amplified in the near term because the Listing Regulations became applicable to the Company only from its listing date of 27th November 2025, so its listed-company compliance framework is in its first part-year.

Structural concentration disclosed but not labelled a risk by the Company: it states it is primarily engaged in one business segment, namely Footwear, with a distributor network across India carrying strong emphasis in the eastern region. There is no export, no second segment and no geographic hedge described anywhere in the routed text.

Structural dependency disclosed but not labelled a risk by the Company: KSR sells entirely under the Khadim brand and its sub-brands (Kalypso, Wash n' Wear, Fliers, FitNxt, Dunford, Pugo) under a License Agreement with Khadim India Limited — an entity over which the Company's KMP and their relatives exercise significant influence, and which is also a counterparty for royalty, purchase of goods, sale of goods, shared services, rent and capital goods. Neither the licence term, renewal conditions nor termination consequences are disclosed in the routed text.

Demand is culturally anchored in weddings, festivals, births and the harvest season, and gold doubles as a savings asset, particularly in rural India.
